overview: Acrylia Approach is the frontline of crystal corruption spreading through Grimling Forest. Acrylia veins erupt from the ground, mutating wildlife and empowering Grimling war-chiefs.
history: Acrylia veins first surfaced after seismic activity beneath Grimling Forest.
Grimling shamans discovered the crystal’s mutagenic properties.
Burrow creatures tunneled into Acrylia veins and became corrupted.
Seru scouts attempted to contain the corruption but were overwhelmed.
Acrylia Loyalists formed to protect the crystal growths.
hooks: A massive Acrylia vein erupts deeper in the forest.
Grimling war-chiefs gain new crystal mutations.
Burrow tunnels collapse into crystal chambers.
Seru scouts attempt a desperate containment operation.
